messages.subject: RE: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs

You can use a slider input with your acceptable range as min and max.
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#sliders

From: Dimitri Liakhovitski

To: shiny-...@googlegroups.com
Subject: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs

Dear Shiny gurus!

in my ui.r I have numeric inputs, e.g.: 

...
numericInput("myseed", "Specify the Random Seed:", 1),
...


Is there a way to restrict a possible range of a given numeric input? E.g., not allow the user to select a value below X and above Y?

Thanks  a lot!
Dimitri
